title: Improve Desired Nodes setting validation error messages

timeline.message: Improve Desired Nodes setting validation error messages
timeline.author: Pooya Salehi

timeline.body: I need to update the REST yaml tests.
We should change the error message since we include what's causing the issue.

timeline.body: I think this is not enough, since the `validationErrors` might contain suppressed exceptions when multiple settings are invalid in a node.

reply.body: Do you mean to go through the whole list and append all messages for each exception? That might make it quite lengthy.
Yes, that was the reason why I suggested to provide the invalid setting names instead of appending the error message
